title: GrapeQA: Graph Augmentation and Pruning for Enhanced Question-Answering
summary: This community centers on the GrapeQA method, a technique designed to improve question-answering systems through graph augmentation and pruning. The method was developed by a collaborative team of six researchers, including Charu Sharma, Dhaval Taunk, and Makarand Tapaswi. It was formally presented in the Companion Proceedings of the ACM Web Conference 2023 (WWW 2023).
key_findings: GrapeQA is a specific method proposed to enhance question-answering capabilities via graph augmentation and pruning.
The method was co-authored by six individuals: Charu Sharma, Dhaval Taunk, Lakshya Khanna, Makarand Tapaswi, Siri Venkata Pavan Kumar Kandru, and Vasudeva Varma.
The work was published in 2023 in the Companion Proceedings of the ACM Web Conference (WWW 2023).
The publication took place in Austin, TX, USA, between April 30 and May 4, 2023.
The paper spans pages 1138–1144 of the conference proceedings.
All listed authors are directly linked to the GrapeQA method via a 'PROPOSED_BY' relationship.
